source_documents.title: Aggregation Induced Emission and Nonlinear Optical Properties of an Intramolecular Charge-Transfer Compound

reference_evidence_units.quote: The δr of BTN is 0.029, which indicates that BTN shows a very effective intramolecular charge transfer.
reference_evidence_units.subject: BTN
reference_evidence_units.statement: Quinoidal bond-length change shows strong ICT.

reference_evidence_units.quote: In nitro compounds with a certain conjugated system, the fluorescence is quenched due to the strong charge transfer in the excited state.
reference_evidence_units.subject: BTN
reference_evidence_units.statement: Non-emissive in solution because of strong excited-state CT.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the intramolecular charge transfer will be eliminated, and the emissions will be recovered.
reference_evidence_units.subject: BTN
reference_evidence_units.statement: Aggregation suppresses the ICT and restores emission.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Strong excited-state ICT quenches BTN in solution; in aggregates intermolecular C-H...O and heteroatom contacts weaken it and emission returns.

mechanism_decisions.rationale: RIM is listed among general AIE mechanisms; the paper's own explanation is ICT suppression.
